name: flamewake_phoenix_declined_or_opponents_turn_stays
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Ferocious — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may pay {R}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Flamewake Phoenix is in seat 0's graveyard; seat 0 controls a 4/4 Ogre and one Mountain. At seat 0's beginning of combat seat 0 declines ('may' false): the Phoenix stays and the Mountain stays untapped. On seat 1's turn, with the Ogre still there, the combat would take an offer, but it is not seat 0's combat: nothing triggers, the Phoenix stays in the graveyard and the Mountain untapped.
